title: review.publish/v1 queue message
description: Pointer message published by the AI Worker onto the `reviews` exchange (routing key `review.publish`) and consumed by the GitHub Publisher (SYSTEM_DESIGN.md §7.2, PIPELINE_SPEC). Carries no findings payload: the publisher reads the findings from PostgreSQL by `run_id`.

Uuid.description: Lowercase, unprefixed UUID (application ids are plain uuid4, no prefixes). `format: uuid` documents intent; the pattern is what actually enforces the shape, since `format` is not asserted unless the validator opts in with a FormatChecker.

CommitSha.description: Git commit SHA-1: 40 lowercase hex characters.

FindingsHash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the sorted findings for this run, matching comments.findings_hash (64 lowercase hex characters, no "sha256:" prefix).

message_id.description: UUIDv5 of run_id + head_sha + findings_hash, computed by the producer: deterministic and stable across redelivery, which is the idempotency key for this message (Р-5).

run_id.description: runs.id this publish message reports on.
